children.value: Reliable and efficient learning requires control of model complexity, economical use of large datasets, and accurate derivative calculations. We study regularization through ridge regression and sparsity, followed by stochastic gradient methods that reduce the cost of individual updates. The final section derives automatic differentiation on computational graphs and applies it to feedforward networks, recurrent models, and optimization procedures.
